layout/empty-input-emits-only-forced-key.note: desktop buildLayoutJson always emits imageWidth/imageHeight (0 when unset) and imageFilter/filterColor (parameter defaults, fileStore.cpp:147-148); the browser's undefined-valued forced keys drop out in JSON

layout/bare-trio.note: desktop always emits imageFilter/filterColor (defaults "none"/"#7c3aed"); the browser omits absent filter fields

layout/session-only-fields-never-exporte.note: desktop's builder takes no session fields at all (they cannot leak); only the always-emitted imageFilter/filterColor defaults differ from the browser payload

layout/falsy-values-still-exported.note: desktop omits WHEN-DEFAULT rather than when-absent: explicit falsy rotationQuarters 0 / customPageWidth 0 / allowFormulas false / formulaX "" are dropped (fileStore.cpp:149-159) where the browser still exports them; imageFilter "" passes through, filterColor default rides along

layout/null-optionals-omitted.note: null optionals map to desktop's absent-parameter defaults (omitted as the browser omits them); only the always-emitted imageFilter/filterColor defaults differ

layout/lines-pass-through-by-reference-u.note: desktop lines never pass through: linesFromJson->lineToJson re-materializes core::Line, dropping unknown keys ("junk") and non-numeric thickness "9" -> default 2 (fileStore.cpp:88-103); browser exports the live array by reference

layout/junk-points-dropped-numeric-strin.note: desktop lineFromJson keeps EVERY points[] entry and zero-fills: no numeric-string coercion (QJsonValue::toDouble never coerces "3") and no junk-point drop (fileStore.cpp:90-93); the shared contract drops junk and coerces

layout/field-type-coercion-and-drops.note: desktop does no type coercion: thickness "3.5" (string) -> default 2 and locked 1 (number) -> default false (QJsonValue toDouble/toBool never coerce, fileStore.cpp:95-98); the shared contract coerces both

layout/non-object-line-entries-skipped.note: desktop linesFromJson turns non-object entries (5, null, "line") into empty default lines instead of skipping them (toObject() on a non-object yields {}, fileStore.cpp:113)

stencilProject/version-as-numeric-string.note: desktop reads version with QJsonValue::toInt (no string coercion): "1" -> 0 -> 'Unrecognized project-file version' (fileStore.cpp:245); the browser coerces the numeric string and accepts

stencilProject/minimal-image-only.note: desktop keeps the raw layout object; a missing layout reads as {} rather than the browser's normalized {"lines":[]} (fileStore.cpp:269)

stencilProject/full-featured.note: desktop parseProjectFile is verbatim: no name trim, no color hex normalization, keywords untrimmed with non-strings -> "" kept, ext case kept, w 800.7 / h "600" -> 0 (toInt never coerces), theme mode case kept (fileStore.cpp:266-285); the browser normalizes all of these

stencilProject/blank-project-truthy-blan.note: desktop blank uses QJsonValue::toBool (no truthiness): "yes" -> false, and blankColor "0f0" is kept raw, not expanded to #00ff00 (fileStore.cpp:278-279)

stencilProject/unknown-top-level-keys-to.note: unknown keys tolerated the same; only the missing-layout {} vs normalized {"lines":[]} difference

stencilProject/layout-lines-hardened-ses.note: desktop stores the layout object VERBATIM (fileStore.cpp:269) — session keys, junk line fields and string coords survive parse (hardening happens later in linesFromJson); the browser hardens at parse

stencilProject/data-url-leading-whitespa.note: leading-whitespace dataUrl decodes the same (indexOf("base64,")); only the missing-layout {} difference

stencilProject/theme-custom-accent-hex-n.note: desktop keeps the theme accent raw ("abc", not expanded to #aabbcc, fileStore.cpp:284) plus the missing-layout {} difference

stencilProject/invalid-theme-and-nonposi.note: desktop performs no validity filtering: bogus ext "...", negative w -5 and an invalid theme {mode:"blue",accent:"#12"} all survive parse (fileStore.cpp:266-285); the browser drops them
